info.name: Miro Developer Platform AI Interaction Logs App metrics (experimental) API

params.name: app_id
params.description: ID of the app to get metrics for.

params.name: startDate
params.description: Start date of the period in UTC format. For example, 2024-12-31.

params.name: endDate
params.description: End date of the period in UTC format. For example, 2024-12-31.

params.name: period
params.description: Group data by this time period.

items.docs:
Returns a list of usage metrics for a specific app for a given time range, grouped by requested time period. This endpoint requires an app management API token. It can be generated in the Your Apps section of Developer Hub.

Required scope

boards:read

Rate limiting

params.name: app_id
params.description: ID of the app to get total metrics for.

items.docs:
Returns total usage metrics for a specific app since the app was created. This endpoint requires an app management API token. It can be generated in your apps section of Developer Hub.

Required scope

boards:read

Rate limiting

Level 1
